answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work. Each submission hangs on the kernel of a task receipt, and the cipher is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the prism of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
